name: Kenneth Krock

about: At Rapp & Krock A Professional Corporation Attorneys At Law in Houston, Texas, Kenneth Krock navigates the intricate world of legal battles, delving into business disagreements, real estate challenges, spanning developer concerns, landlord/tenant issues and construction claims, insurance coverage disputes, bankruptcy litigation, employment conflicts and financial-related cases. His journey through the legal landscape has seen him advocate for clients in both state and federal courts, at trial and appellate levels, as well as representing both debtors and creditors in various bankruptcy courts.

Mr. Krock’s academic path began with a B.B.A. degree in management from Texas A&M University in 1993, followed by a J.D. cum laude from the University of Houston Law Center in 1996. He has been practicing law in Texas since 1996 and in the District of Columbia since 1999. He is also admitted to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit, the U.S. District Courts for the Southern, Northern, Eastern and Western Districts of Texas, and the U.S. Bankruptcy Courts for the Southern, Northern, Eastern and Western Districts of Texas.

A respected figure in legal circles, Mr. Krock has contributed to the Texas State Bar Court Rules Committee from 2007 to 2013 and the Unauthorized Practice of Law Committee of the State of Texas from 2005 to 2006. Beyond these roles, he is actively engaged with the Houston A&M Club, the Special Olympics Texas East Region Resource Board and the American Bar Association. His dedication to the legal field is recognized through his Life Fellowship with the Texas Bar Foundation and his Fellowship with the Houston Bar Foundation. He is also a proud member of the Order of the Barons, the Order of the Coif, the Houston Bar Association and the Texas Aggie Bar Association.

Rated as “Superb” on Avvo, Mr. Krock holds an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell. Before establishing his current firm, he was a shareholder at a Houston law firm and a partner at another legal organization with offices across the U.S. and in London.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
Kenneth Krock is a debt relief agent. He helps people file for bankruptcy relief under the Bankruptcy Code.
